decks.notes: The deck focuses on assembling the Amulet of Vigor with other ramp cards to quickly get Primeval Titan onto the battlefield. By utilizing the Titan's ability to search for lands, the deck can set up powerful land combos like Scapeshift to win the game. The inclusion of Urza's Saga and Lotus Field adds versatility and additional combo potential to the deck, allowing for explosive and consistent plays. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with large creatures, powerful lands, and efficient mana generation to secure victory.

The deck is focused on assembling the Amulet Titan combo by utilizing cards like Primeval Titan, Amulet of Vigor, and Urza's Saga to ramp up and generate mana quickly. The combination of lands like Simic Growth Chamber, Gruul Turf, and Lotus Field with bounce lands allows for explosive plays and the ability to search for key pieces with cards like Summoner's Pact and Tolaria West. By efficiently ramping up mana and utilizing land synergy, the deck aims to quickly ramp into powerful threats like Primeval Titan and Cultivator Colossus to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck focuses on applying quick and aggressive pressure on the opponent, utilizing a combination of efficient creatures, burn spells, and disruptive cards to overwhelm and outpace the opponent. By utilizing cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Galvanic Discharge to deal damage directly to the opponent or their creatures, while also having access to cards like Ranger-Captain of Eos and Static Prison to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to be proactive and maintain a fast pace throughout the game, aiming to close out games quickly and decisively.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. The deck also includes a control element with cards like All Is Dust and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's board state. Karn, the Great Creator is utilized to search for important artifacts like Ugin, Eye of the Storms and Talisman of Resilience. The combination of ramp and control allows the deck to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats while also maintaining control of the game.

The deck focuses on ramping into powerful Eldrazi creatures like Ulamog and Emrakul while controlling the board with mass removal spells like Kozilek's Return and Malevolent Rumble. The deck also utilizes cards like Karn, the Great Creator to shut down opponent's artifacts and Ugin, Eye of the Storms to provide additional removal and card advantage. The mana base includes lands like Eldrazi Temple and Utopia Sprawl to accelerate mana production and help cast the big Eldrazi threats earlier in the game. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with massive threats while disrupting their game plan.

The deck focuses on using ramp cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talisman of Impulse to quickly generate mana and get ahead of the opponent. It then aims to control the board with cards like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker to close out the game. By combining ramp, control, and big threats, this deck can overwhelm opponents and secure victory.

The deck focuses on using ramp spells and mana rocks to quickly get to the powerful Eldrazi creatures, Karn, and All Is Dust. The main strategy is to control the board with powerful colorless spells like Ugin, Eye of the Storms and All Is Dust while ramping up to play the huge Eldrazi creatures like Ulamog and Sowing Mycospawn. Karn, the Great Creator can also shut down artifacts while providing utility with his abilities. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with huge threats and powerful control spells.

The deck focuses on putting pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures and powerful spells. It aims to ramp up quickly with cards like Noble Hierarch and Fight Rigging, allowing for early aggression. The creatures in the deck have strong abilities that can help maintain board control and deal significant damage each turn. The Great Henge is a key card that can provide additional card draw and ramp, further strengthening the deck's strategy. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent quickly before they have a chance to stabilize.

The deck focuses on using instant reanimation effects to cheat powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul and Ulamog into play quickly. Cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Through the Breach allow for explosive plays, while support cards like Devourer of Destiny and Yggdrasil provide additional value and protection. The deck also includes a small burn package with Lightning Bolt and Kozilek's Command for extra reach. The goal is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with fast, powerful threats before they have time to respond effectively.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Ulamog, then using Goryo's Vengeance to cheat them into play. It uses cards like Ephemerate and Solitude to protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes cards like Tainted Indulgence and Consign to Memory for additional graveyard manipulation and disruption. With a mix of reanimation spells, control elements, and powerful threats, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory through a powerful combo.

This deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Cragganwick Cremator using cards such as Goryo's Vengeance and The Underworld Cookbook. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's hand and game plan while setting up its own combo. With a mix of ways to tutor for key pieces and efficient removal like Lightning Bolt and Fatal Push, this deck aims to win the game through explosive creature plays and disruption, making it a formidable opponent in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck focuses on utilizing Jeskai Ascendancy alongside cheap artifacts and card draw to quickly generate a large amount of mana and draw through the deck, eventually leading to a win condition such as Infinite Mana or massive creature pump. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student are crucial pieces in the combo, while cards like Mox Amber and Mishra's Bauble help with acceleration. The deck is streamlined with a low land count and powerful synergies between cards to create powerful explosive turns and overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to assemble the Jeskai Ascendancy combo as quickly as possible to generate massive amounts of mana and card advantage, allowing the player to power out powerful threats and overwhelm the opponent. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble help to cycle through the deck efficiently, while Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student can provide extra card draw. The inclusion of Mox Opal and Urza's Saga help to accelerate the combo even further. Overall, the deck aims to win through a fast and explosive combo.

The deck focuses on using Jeskai Ascendancy to generate a powerful combo engine by casting multiple spells in a turn, triggering various effects to create a dominant board state. Emry, Lurker of the Loch, Mox Opal, and Mishra's Bauble provide additional value and mana generation, while Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps dig for combo pieces. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Pithing Needle and Portable Hole to control the opponent's game plan. Urza's Saga and Meticulous Archive offer further utility and card advantage in executing the combo strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing Jeskai Ascendancy as a key engine to generate value and dig through the deck quickly. It combines artifacts like Mox Opal and Mishra's Bauble with creatures like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to create a powerful combo that can generate mana and draw cards. The deck also includes cards like Urza's Saga and Galvanic Blast to provide additional tools for winning the game. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells and card advantage.

This deck focuses on using efficient creatures and disruptive spells to apply pressure on the opponent quickly. With cards like Tarmogoyf and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, the deck aims to win the game by attacking aggressively while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and Wrenn and Six to provide additional value and control the board. The inclusion of Urza's Saga helps generate additional threats and card advantage, creating a versatile and powerful aggressive strategy.

This Jund aggro deck aims to control the board with hand disruption spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize while deploying efficient threats like Tarmogoyf, Ragavan, and Nethergoyf to pressure the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Liliana of the Veil and Wrenn and Six provide additional value and disruption, creating a powerful and versatile strategy that can adapt to different matchups. The deck also utilizes lands like Urza's Saga and Boseiju, Who Endures to further enhance its game plan and give it an edge against various decks in the Modern format.

The deck focuses on utilizing a variety of creatures and spells to ramp up mana quickly and efficiently, ultimately leading to the ability to activate Goblin Charbelcher to deal massive damage to opponents. With a lack of land cards in the deck, the strategy revolves around manipulating and countering opponent's plays while setting up for a winning combo. Subtlety and Tameshi, Reality Architect provide control and disruption, while Fallaji Archaeologist and Thundertrap Trainer help with card advantage and protection. The deck also includes various counter spells and removal options to maintain board control and protect the win condition.

The deck aims to assemble a winning combo using Tameshi, Reality Architect and Fallaji Archaeologist to generate a large amount of mana with Hydroelectric Specimen and Thundertrap Trainer. The win condition is to use Goblin Charbelcher to deal lethal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes control elements such as Spell Snare, Pact of Negation, and Disrupting Shoal to protect the combo. Additionally, cards like Whir of Invention and Talisman of Progress help to find key pieces of the combo quickly. The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Jwari Disruption, Sink into Stupor, and Suppression Ray.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and pump spells to deal a large amount of damage quickly. By utilizing low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Slickshot Show-Off, along with pump spells like Mutagenic Growth and Assault Strobe, the deck aims to rapidly reduce the opponent's life total before they can react. The inclusion of cards like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart provide additional reach to finish off the opponent. Overall, this deck aims to be aggressive and proactive in its strategy.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly deploy low-cost aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while also utilizing burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart to pressure the opponent and clear the way for attacks. The deck also features card draw and selection through cards like Expressive Iteration and mishra's bauble to maintain speed and consistency. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of quick creature damage and direct burn spells.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly play low-cost spells and creatures to deal direct damage to the opponent, aiming to win the game as fast as possible. The deck includes cards that allow for card selection and mana fixing to ensure a consistent flow of aggressive plays. UR Aggro utilizes prowess creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler, along with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart, to keep pressure on the opponent and finish them off before they can stabilize. The deck is designed to be fast, efficient, and relentless in its attack strategy.

The deck revolves around playing aggressively with strong threats like Murktide Regent, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Subtlety and Counterspell to control the game and protect its threats. Mishra's Bauble and Preordain help filter through the deck for key cards, while Lightning Bolt provides additional removal. The mana base is optimized for consistent casting of spells and includes fetch lands for deck thinning. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control of the game.

The key concept of this Modern UrzaTron Control deck is to utilize the powerful Urza lands to ramp up mana quickly and cast big Eldrazi threats that disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck focuses on controlling the board with cards like Thought-Knot Seer and Glaring Fleshraker, while also providing versatile removal options with cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Kozilek's Command. By assembling the UrzaTron lands and dropping huge threats like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory through sheer power and disruption.

Utilizing fast mana and graveyard manipulation, this deck aims to cheat giant Eldrazi creatures into play quickly to overwhelm the opponent. By using cards like Through the Breach and Goryo's Vengeance, the deck can put Emrakul or Ulamog into play from the hand or graveyard for a devastating surprise attack. The deck also includes ways to control the board and disrupt the opponent's plans, making it a versatile and powerful combo deck capable of winning in a variety of ways.
